subject: Re: Payment Confirmation and Invoice Request
body:
[HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED]

Dear David Lee,

Thank you for your email regarding your registration payment and invoice request for ICCBDA 2027.

We are unable to confirm whether your payment has been received at this stage. The payment record requires review by the conference secretariat. We also note your request for an official invoice for university reimbursement; information about invoice issuance is not currently available, and this request requires review by the conference secretariat.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
ICCBDA 2027 Conference Secretariat
review_reason: Payment receipt status cannot be verified from the fact card, and the invoice request requires human review because no invoice policy is provided.
